deadline.value: The PhD application and all materials are due February 1, 2027.
deadline.quote: For fall 2027 admission, the online application must be submitted by February 1, 2027

fee_waiver.value: Only a small number of waivers, and a Mechanical Engineering faculty member must endorse the petition.
fee_waiver.quote: We can only make a small number of waivers for outstanding students, who need to find a faculty in the Department of Mechanical Engineering to endorse their waiver petition.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional and not considered unless you submit them.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores will be optional for applicants applying for admission.

toefl_min.value: Recommended TOEFL 96; a recommendation, not a hard minimum.
toefl_min.quote: The following are recommended: TOEFL 96, IELTS 7, and Duolingo 125.

ielts_min.value: Recommended IELTS 7; a recommendation, not a hard minimum.
ielts_min.quote: The following are recommended: TOEFL 96, IELTS 7, and Duolingo 125.

english_waiver.value: The department waives the test for a bachelor's or master's from an 'English-speaking University'; the page does not say whether English-medium Indian universities count, so confirm with the department (megrinfo@me.rochester.edu).
english_waiver.quote: from an English-speaking University do not need to submit these scores. | The requirement will automatically be waived at the time applications are reviewed.

supervisor.value: No advisor is needed to be admitted; students find one by the end of the second semester of year one.
supervisor.quote: The first year of PhD studies, students are required to meet with faculty and determine a faculty research advisor by the end of their second semester.

funding.value: PhD students receive a full tuition waiver and stipend, detailed in the offer letter.
funding.quote: PhD students receive a full tuition waiver and stipend.

entry_route.value: Apply directly with a BS or BA.
entry_route.quote: Applicants can apply directly to the PhD program with an undergraduate degree.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: The page lists the PhD deadline above the MS deadline (May 15, 2027).
